description: Required and optional fields for a Zeek conn.log record delivered as one Kafka JSON message.

requiredFields.name: id
requiredFields.notes: upstream record id, namespaced with sensor to form EventId

requiredFields.name: ts
requiredFields.notes: epoch seconds, may include fractional milliseconds

optionalFields.name: service
optionalFields.notes: dns | http | ssl | other, absent if unidentified

optionalFields.name: duration
optionalFields.notes: seconds, absent for connections with no data

invalidRecordPolicy: Malformed JSON or a missing required field routes to netsec.conn.dlq.v1 with a reason code; unknown additive fields are tolerated and ignored.
